## Description

Applies rough path signature transformations to multi-horizon return paths to compress high-frequency time series into non-linear tensor features for equity factor models.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency factor modeling, path-dependent trend following, non-linear asset return forecasting.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Funds, Systematic CTA Funds.

## Required data

High-frequency tick-level price series, multi-horizon OHLCV bars, fundamental factor panels.

## Caveats

Signature truncation level must be carefully controlled to prevent combinatorial feature explosion.
